research_object: Early cortical progenitor-to-neuron developmental transition in human and chimpanzee stem-cell-derived organoid models
required_invariants: Do not frame one candidate as the sole genetic basis of humanity.
Maintain a distinction between human-lineage sequence candidates, molecular effects, and causal developmental effects.
Require reciprocal humanization and ancestral reversion for the primary causal claim.
Treat organoid fidelity, line identity, batch, region composition, and developmental alignment as measurable alternatives rather than nuisance prose.
The output must remain design-only and may not report newly observed experimental results.
recommended_candidate_classes: human accelerated regulatory elements and their 3D contacts
cell-state-specific regulatory modules shared by the two classes
